meta.title: SEO Agency in Israel | DC Project
meta.description: SEO optimization for businesses in Israel. On-page SEO, technical audit, link building and long-term organic growth in Google — in Hebrew, Russian and English. Full transparency, real rankings.

seo.label: SEO
seo.h1: SEO & Organic Search Promotion in Israel
body: SEO is not a quick win — it's a compounding investment that pays dividends for years. DC Project offers full-cycle SEO for businesses in Israel looking to rank in Google for Hebrew, English and Russian search queries.

Our process starts with a complete technical audit covering site speed, indexing and mobile performance. Then we build a keyword strategy from actual search-demand data and map it to your site architecture.

On-page SEO includes title tags, meta descriptions, H1–H6 structure, internal linking, schema markup, image optimization and content that satisfies search intent — not just keyword density. For authority we develop a backlink strategy using guest posts, digital PR and relevant directory submissions, with no black-hat shortcuts.
You receive a monthly report with rankings, organic traffic and a clear plan for the next 30 days. GEO / AI search optimization is available as an add-on.

geo-ai-seo.label: GEO / AI
geo-ai-seo.h1: GEO & AI Search Optimization for Forward-Thinking Businesses
body: Search is changing. More and more people don't scroll through ten blue links anymore, they ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Google's AI Overview, and they read the single answer they're given. The question for your business is simple: when AI gives that answer, does it mention you?

That's what GEO, Generative Engine Optimization, does. DC Project positions your business to appear inside AI-generated answers, the fastest-growing visibility channel of the coming years. While your competitors still fight over traditional rankings, you can be the brand the AI recommends.

GEO works best as a premium layer on top of solid SEO. We structure your content so AI models can understand, trust, and cite it: clear entity signals, authoritative answers to real questions, and the technical markup that helps machines read your site correctly.
This is an emerging field. We help businesses build visibility in AI search now, while the channel is still developing.
